verdict.rationale: CDP ships one narrow, first-party event-triggered automation. A deposit destination can be configured as a liquidation address, so when funds arrive the account is credited automatically and the funds can be converted to another asset. Webhooks only deliver notifications for a developer to act on, so they are building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-definable rules engine (custom conditions and arbitrary actions), event types beyond incoming deposits, chaining or multi-step automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A destination can also act as a liquidation address, automatically converting incoming funds into a different asset before crediting the account.
When a deposit arrives, the corresponding account's balance is credited automatically.
Provision stable onchain addresses that auto-credit a custodial account, with optional auto-liquidation
